text:
Hana: Heads-up: large hospital system asked for an on-prem POC in a physically isolated datacenter. They want: delivery options, upgrade cadence, SBOM/key provenance, and clear commercial uplift. Need short answers.

Leo: Do they insist on physical courier only or can we support an approved jumpbox pull over an internal staging host?

Priyanka: Customer prefers couriered media for initial load but can accept staged pulls after the initial seed. CVE SLA requested: 30 days critical, 90 days high.

Jon: We can provide both. Options: (A) encrypted USB with signed manifest + checksum; (B) VM image via vetted staging host using scp from an approved firewall egress point.

PS_Ops: Bundle sizes: full image ~11GB compressed; security minibundles ~<180MB. For strict bandwidth limits we shard into 256MB parts and provide sha256 manifest + reassembly helper.

Hana: They asked about signing/key provenance text for their security questionnaire. Suggested phrasing?

SecurityBot: Suggested: "We deliver an SBOM (redacted) and a signer certificate chain. Signing is performed within FIPS 140-2/3 certified HSMs; private keys never leave the HSM. HSM attestation and audit logs can be provided under NDA."

Priyanka: Ops notes: offline license activation required. We'll supply signed activation tokens and CLI import instructions. Also include offline cert rotation steps (rotation bundle signed by our HSM). Recommend quarterly rotation unless compliance requires more frequent.

Leo: Commercials: one-time packaging & signing fee + PS for chunking/testing (estimate 10 hours) + concierge staging premium for first 90 days (about 15% uplift). Emergency hotfix path (48-72h) as a priced add-on.

Jon: Verification snippets to share with their team:
```
# verify chunks and signature
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
# reassemble and sanity-check
cat part_* > bundle.tar.gz && tar -tzf bundle.tar.gz
```

Hana: Plan: Leo to draft quote lines; Priyanka to produce a 1-page runbook + sample sanitized SBOM and the chunker script; Jon to add CLI activation steps. Send consolidated reply by EOD tomorrow.

Priyanka: Compliance note: they want the SBOM sample before procurement signs SOW. I'll prioritize redaction and upload.

SecurityBot: Reminder: never post private key material in channel; only cert chains and redacted logs.

Hana: Thanks all — if no objections I'll send the reply tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
